capture.initial_opportunity: Provider contract is already in durable bundled vendor/protocol-1.md. Empty retained memories are failed capture outcomes but not automatically instruction disobedience.
capture.scoring: Use faithful prose or structured information; complementary actual records can preserve facts. Never infer missing facts from correct code. Explicit contradiction fails; ambiguous shorthand is unverified. Core facts and all retained commentary are separate judgments.

guidance_exposure.evidence: Record executed command receipt and matching captured tool result/index separately. Raw administrative prime output is setup evidence only. Matching text elsewhere can establish exposure without proving prime was its sole source.

prior_use.bulk_rule: A bulk memories projection can expose applicable information and support work, but without explicit recall it receives neither tested lookup-route credit nor primary routed-handoff credit. Report its information exposure/use separately.
prior_use.denominators: All54planned eligible legs primary; applicable/conflicting/topic-related entry record denominators secondary. Preserve unstarted/unassessed slots and failures.

control.interpretation: Zero writes is not sufficient control success. Genuine new findings can warrant capture; supplied case facts alone do not establish a permanent convention. Successful attachment and full accumulated behavior are separate outcomes.

strict_intersections.primary: all6artifacts +faithful initial/current/history +routed primary use on2/4/5 +no unsupported standing/history mutation +no duplicate control capture
strict_intersections.compatible_secondary: same components with separately substantiated post-test confirmation use permitted, matching earlier study interpretation
strict_intersections.limits: A core intersection does not certify every stored claim or procedural step. Source alternatives prevent exclusive memory causality.
